description: This file defines the `ShortcutHelper` class, which manages Android app shortcuts including creating, updating, refreshing, and fetching favicons for shortcuts. It interacts with the Android ShortcutManager API to provide dynamic shortcut management features.

classes.name: ShortcutHelper
classes.description: A helper class to manage dynamic and pinned app shortcuts in Android applications, including creation, refresh, enabling/disabling, and favicon fetching.

methods.name: ShortcutHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ShortcutHelper with a Context.

methods.name: maybeRestoreAllDynamicShortcuts
methods.description: Checks existing dynamic shortcuts and optionally restores them if none exist.

methods.name: reportShortcutUsed
methods.description: Reports that a shortcut with a specific ID was used.

methods.name: callShortcutManager
methods.description: Wrapper method to call ShortcutManager APIs with error handling and rate limiting.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Returns a list of all mutable dynamic and pinned shortcuts, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: refreshShortcuts
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes shortcuts if they are stale or if forced.

methods.name: createShortcutForUrl
methods.description: Creates a ShortcutInfo object for a given URL.

methods.name: setSiteInformation
methods.description: Sets label and icon information for a ShortcutInfo.Builder based on a Uri.

methods.name: setExtras
methods.description: Adds timestamp extras to a ShortcutInfo.Builder.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Ensures URL strings start with http:// or https://.

methods.name: addWebSiteShortcut
methods.description: Adds a new dynamic shortcut for a website URL.

methods.name: removeShortcut
methods.description: Removes a shortcut by its ShortcutInfo.

methods.name: fetchFavicon
methods.description: Fetches the favicon bitmap from a given Uri.
